title: DAYSHA image library originals versus references
scope: All indexed Library image records dated Oct 18 2026 or later in /DAYSHA and related unfiled images with royal/atelier titles. Items outside these bounds may exist.
referencePolicy: Do not publish supplied dress reference images, screenshot corrections, franchise dress input, or unreviewed generations as approved Daysha original artwork.
accountingPolicy: One physical gown can have multiple scenes; no paid gold or dates assigned on an image alone. Montages are not multiple purchases.
notes: This is a provenance and upload queue; it does not claim that unapproved pictures were transferred.
Registered images preserve existing public entries without multiplying copies.
Nineteen candidate images in separate pending manifest are still unverified for publication unless separately listed as approved.
